svg.title: Great One of the Night of Time: The Universe (Book T deck, painted with its symbols)
svg.desc: Above, Earth and Saturn, the Key's attribution; below, the letter Tau (ת); Key XXI, Path 32. Its ring: number 78 in Book T's order, with its part of the zodiac lit. The painting: https://pub-71ebbc217e6247ecacb85126a6616699.r2.dev/flow-image-gen/1791650573659-8q4bx2ymq62.png (AI painting from Book T's words, prompt by PlayfulProcess, CC BY-SA 4.0). Glyphs drawn for recursive-tarot (CC BY-SA 4.0); composed by scripts/build_book_t_painted_symbols.py.
